notes.title: WORKING ON THE FINAL LEVEL AND INVITING YOU TO SUBMIT DUCK ART FOR THE GAME
notes.content:
[p][b]So, i'm currently working on the final level for the game.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]As some of you might already know, i use trenchbroom, old quake level editor, to create the geometry for the levels in project_Structure_01. Here is some editor pics from work done in recent days:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149372/378f21c932ad72fcede2e45a5bbecbfe57897e84.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149372/c62e59053fecd00782003d8c11ea5cc5e6dcf02c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I also imported what i have so far into unreal for setting up the some of the basic things for what level is gonna need like, footstep sounds, respawning when falling and also to test some lighting and other stuff.[/p][p]couple pics from unreal:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149372/96c5bd4919a01a0687969e74a82c5b08ad00f2a6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149372/cf381f1804b78a7696929fa06d778a923a7660e5.png"][/img][/p][p][b]And finally, the final level will also feature an art gallery with room for like 20 to 30 works of art. I invite you, the players, to fill it with duck related artwork! You can submit art to the gallery through discord. Here's picture of the geometry for the gallery:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149372/bd72dcc70400c16bb18be3f8b992609f3590e608.png"][/img][/p][p]This is all very early work in progress and lots of more work is required. Just wanted to let you guys know that i'm slowly progressing here. [/p][p][b]Thank you!  Feel free to hop into discord to follow the progress more closely.  [/b]Discord link: [url="https://discord.com/invite/FnqZRHtTdX"]https://discord.com/invite/FnqZRHtTdX[/url]


[/p]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE FOR UPCOMING NEXTFEST
notes.content:
[b]DEMO UPDATE PATCH NOTES[/b]

[b]General Changes:[/b]
-Added everything from 'Fog' playtest (except the 'Fog' level)
-Added film grain
-Mouse sensitivity slider in pause menu now works properly
-Added glowing balls that increase players glow range and intensity momentarily when collected
-Controls tutorial now fits the screen better
-Added couple more ducks

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149372/44a3de4f49ecd96e279b784b7e19c1717c5a4e2f.jpg[/img]

[b]Pillar Hall Changes:[/b]
-Fixed the elevator softlock
-Added platforming challenge

[b]Ledges Changes:[/b]
-Added new hidden alternate path
-Added new ambient track
-Added painting
-Added trees

And bunch of small tweaks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149372/ca8d27b09369a30c0cb020d4c4670d8a93fbaea1.jpg[/img]

[b]Now that the patchnotes are out of the way, lets talk about how the full release is coming along.[/b]

[b]The progress is as follows:[/b]
-Third level called 'Fog' is completed and tested, but i'll prolly add some tweaks to it at some point. 
-Fourth level called 'Tower' is mainly missing end transition scene and needs some tweaking in couple aspects, but it's pretty much completed.
-Fifth and the final level called 'City' is still in planning phase, but i'll start working on level geometry for it fairly soon. That's about it.
-Still hoping to have enough willpower to complete the game before end of the year. Appreciate everyone who's tried the demo out and your kind words mean the world to me.

Thank you!

Feel free to hop into discord to follow the progress more closely. 
Discord link: https://discord.com/invite/FnqZRHtTdX

notes.title: New Level Beta Playtest
notes.content:
[b]Hey![/b]

Third level called "FOG" is now undergoing playtesting. It's quite big level with playtime being around 30min. In this level you'll get to explore your way out of the "dungeons" mentioned in previous level and take few steps closer to reaching the city. Watch out for the ducks, i don't know what they are planning...

[b]BUILD PS01_0.6_FOG_BETA PATCH NOTES[/b]

[b]General Changes:[/b]
-added new level called "FOG"
-added bloom
-changed square lamp model white part to be more visible

[b]Ledges Changes:[/b]
-added safety rails to prevent falling in some areas
-added new duck (non collectable)
-added couple new mushrooms
-fixed some geometry mistakes

and bunch of some small tweaks to things that i have forgotten what they are, but they are there.

notes.title: DEMO RELEASED!
notes.content:
[b]Hey![/b]

[b]Demo has been released![/b]

Head to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183050/project_Structure_01_Demo/]Demo page[/url] and try it out. Feel free to leave a review. Thank you.

[b]Patch notes since last test:[/b]

Post processing changes:
-Toned flickering thing down even more
-Toned down camera barrel effect

General changes:
-Instead of throwing controls into players face in first level, added "hold c to show controls"
-Added tab button to controls to see amount of ducks collected so far
-Limited angle on looking up with mouse to get rid of player head popping in the view
-Greatly reduced amount of ducks, changed many placements and attempted to make it more interesting by adding platforming to some of them
-Reduced size of duck text and removed word 'secret' from it
-Made demo ending scene camera transition smoother at start
-Some shadow issues fixed

Changes to 'Ledges' level:
-Added mushrooms to guide player through dark parts of the tower climb
-Added pipes to one area
-Added some obscure lore/story in form of few wall writings
-Added one more ukkeli sighting
-Added new small area
-Added wall painting
